column1: # WetherLoggerBox 4MB ESP32-C3: single app (no OTA) + large LittleFS + coredump
# 2026-09-14: server-link (WiFiClientSecure/HTTPClient TLS client) grew the app past the
#   old 0x160000 (1.44MB) limit (~1.45MB) -> would not boot. App enlarged to 0x1C0000
# NOTE: offsets changed -> LittleFS reformats on next boot (saved WiFi/logs/token lost;
#   WiFi falls back to config.local.h defaults
# ASCII only: PlatformIO parses this file as the system ANSI codepage (cp932 on JP Windows).
